notes: Insurer: revenue = "Total revenues" to 2022; from 2023 the IFRS 17 "Insurance revenue" line (not like-for-like with 2022 and earlier, and below the total revenue that data vendors show).
Where a later report restates a year, the latest published figure is used (restated: true); 2022 is the IFRS 17 restatement printed in the 2023 report.
capex = purchases of PP&E where printed alone; 2014-2017 print only additions to tangible and intangible assets combined.
Reporting currency USD; dividendPerShare is the CHF amount declared for the year.
IFRS 17 / IFRS 9 adopted 2023; 2022 restated in the 2023 statements.

FY2025 totalAssets: Consolidated balance sheet, Total assets
